notes: Display defaults for the fluoro view. Pulse-rate options come from data/imaging/imaging.json; these pick defaults and the look.

defaultPulseRate.note: Chosen from the sourced options 3.75, 7.5, 15 and 30.

noiseSigma.note: Quantum-noise standard deviation at the default dose per pulse.

background.note: Gray level of unattenuated field before window/level.

contrastPuffMaxOpacity.note: M1 stand-in for contrast: the lumen opacifies while RT is held; replaced by the flow model in M2.

roadmapOutlineOpacity.note: M1 stand-in for roadmap: vessel outline overlay toggled by X or R.

wireOpacity.note: Fraction of the beam a guidewire absorbs along a path as long as its diameter, before the rod model's radiopacity factors. M1 transmittance stand-in until spec 08's ray-integrated attenuation; wires show darker than catheters. Added in M1 phase D.

catheterOpacity.note: The same for catheter material: a solid path as long as the outer diameter. Through a tube only the wall attenuates, so a catheter shows as two edge lines with a lighter lumen. Added in M1 phase D.

softTissueBandOpacity.note: Opacity at the center of the faint soft-tissue band drawn around each phantom: a cylinder along the phantom axis, so its shadow fades toward its edges. Added in M1 phase D.

softTissueBandMargin.note: The soft-tissue band's radius reaches this far beyond the phantom's widest lumen, and its ends this far beyond the inlet and the caps. Added in M1 phase D.

collimatedGray.note: Gray level behind the collimator blades. Added in M1 phase D.

roadmapOutlineGray.note: Gray level of the roadmap outline stand-in, blended in at roadmapOutlineOpacity. Added in M1 phase D.

roadmapOutlineWidth.note: Width of the roadmap outline: the vessel mask's edge is found this many pixels to each side. Added in M1 phase D.

tubeRadialSegments.note: Sides of every device and vessel tube mesh, in both views. Added in M1 phase D.

vesselColor.note: Color of the translucent phantom lumen. Added in M1 phase D.

sheathColor.note: Color of the introducer sheath, from the valve to the sheath tip. Added in M1 phase D.

backgroundColor.note: Background of the 3D view. Added in M1 phase D.

cameraFov.note: Vertical field of view of the orbit camera. Added in M1 phase D.

cameraDistance.note: The orbit camera starts this many bounding-box diagonals from the phantom's center, looking along the C-arm's beam so both views start alike. Added in M1 phase D.

hemisphereLightIntensity.note: Sky-and-ground fill light. Added in M1 phase D.

keyLightIntensity.note: Directional key light from above the camera. Added in M1 phase D.

surfaceRoughness.note: Roughness of every lit surface in the 3D view (lumen, devices, sheath); none is metallic. Added in M1 phase D.

uiRefreshRate.note: React HUD reads the latest snapshot at this rate; the canvas renders every frame.

toastDuration.note: How long a toast stays on screen. Added in M1 phase D.

blockedMessageDebounce.note: A blocked action's message is not shown again within this time, so holding a blocked push does not flood the screen (prompts/M1-foundations.md §2). Added in M1 phase D.

tipForceFullScale.note: Tip force bar full scale. A display scale, not an injury threshold. Added in M1 phase D.

wallStressFullScaleTime.note: The wall-stress bar is full after this long at the tip-force full scale: its full scale is tipForceFullScale times this time, in N·s (the unit table has no N·s). A display scale, not an injury threshold. Added in M1 phase D.

alarmToneFrequency.note: Alarm tone played with the hub-force-danger rumble, so rumble is always backed by sound (spec 00 §9; docs/M1-plan.md D22). Added in M1 phase D.

alarmToneGain.note: Peak gain, 0..1. Added in M1 phase D.

blockedToneFrequency.note: Softer tone for a blocked action (docs/M1-plan.md D22). Added in M1 phase D.

blockedToneGain.note: Peak gain, 0..1. Added in M1 phase D.

targetFrameRate.note: The frame rate the app aims for: the startup tier benchmark compares physics time with autoSelect.maxPhysicsPerFrame per frame at this rate, and the perf overlay reports against it. Added in M1 phase C (docs/M1-plan.md D17).

defaultSourceToImageDistance.note: Starting source-to-image distance, inside the sourced 89-123.5 cm range (imaging.json gantry). Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D18).

defaultZoomField.note: Starting zoom field: the largest of imaging.json gantry.zoomFields. Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D18).

defaultTableHeight.note: Starting table height, the middle of the sourced 74-102 cm range (imaging.json table). Added in M1 phase B (docs/M1-plan.md D18).
